name: faceless-script-swarm
description: Research trending, evergreen topics for the channel niche and write fact-checked Shorts scripts into scripts/queue/ for the free render pipeline.

stages.name: Topic research
stages.task: Read channel.yaml (niche) and history.jsonl (already covered). Propose 5 fresh topics with high curiosity value that are filmable with generic stock footage. For each, collect 4-6 verifiable facts with a source URL (Wikipedia or better).

stages.name: Script writing
stages.task: For each topic write scripts/queue/<YYYYMMDD>-<slug>.json matching scripts/example.json: 110-140 words total, first sentence is the hook, 5-8 scenes, an "image" prompt per scene for the AI image generator (same characters, place and era across scenes, no text in the image) plus 1-3 concrete stock-footage search terms as backup, last scene asks a question. Put sources at the end of the description.

stages.name: Fact check and policy review
stages.task: Check every claim in scripts/queue/*.json against its sources; fix or delete anything unverifiable. Reject clickbait titles that the video does not deliver on (YouTube policy). Validate each file with: python -m faceless.check scripts/queue
